Name: Kobold Farmer
Author: timeexplorers
Description:
A mod that changes the farmer from a boring human into a lovely kobold. 

This is my first mod so please inform me of any issues you find.
There are some animation issues like the tail going beserk when using tools while facing up.
Also there may be some issues with other clothes mods as I had to edit the shirts and pants for the tail to work, if there's a better way of doing this please let me know.

Based of the mod made by Giik: https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/kobold-farmer-1-1.147447/
